name: pcp
description: Protocols for agent-driven engineering: recording intent so it survives the session, and running a roadmap through plan, review, implement, verify without the agent grading its own homework.

plugins.name: pcp
plugins.description: Project Constitution Protocol. Record decisions, constraints and lessons as short coded entries so intent survives context loss, instead of restating it in comments and chat.

plugins.name: steps
plugins.description: Run a roadmap phase by phase under separation of duties: plan, review the plan, implement, review the implementation, fix, verify. The agent that writes a thing never grades it.
